sentences.text: No: for this case, a Tier 4 UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges on a floating-rate loan granted for business purpose to a micro and small enterprise.

The current UCB directions for loans sanctioned or renewed on or after 1 January 2026 state that, for business-purpose floating-rate loans to individuals and Micro and Small Enterprises, a Tier 4 UCB shall not levy prepayment charges.

The older RBI directions that also said a Tier 4 Primary (Urban) Co-operative bank shall not levy any pre-payment charges on business-purpose floating-rate loans to individuals and MSEs are no longer in force.
